text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Military ruler General Sani Abacha approves commissioning of the eastern Onitsha port to boost commerce in the region.
- Nigeria's fuel crisis enters the sixth day as tankers have been unable to lift supplies at depots since Friday.
- Robbers in Lagos kill two members of "Operation Sweep" -- a combined anti-crime task force of the navy, police and soldiers -- in the third such attack within three months.
- State phone company Nigerian Telecommunications has ordered additional pay-phone boxes for installation in five cities, spokesman Tayo Ekundayo says.
- The Nigerian environment is under serious threat and needs to be protected through a tight legal framework, Mohammed Uwais, chief justice of the federation, tells an environment seminar in Lagos.
